items.title: Start Songs with MIDI: Suno adds MIDI file uploads as a starting point in Create
items.excerpt: Suno now lets users upload a MIDI file as the starting point for a generated song in Create, so producers can steer AI generation from their own melody, chords or arrangement.

items.title: iZotope Photon is a local stem separation and denoising tool that runs off your GPU
items.excerpt: iZotope has launched Photon, an AI-powered stem separation and audio cleanup tool powered by 12 custom-trained models that process audio locally on the computer's GPU rather than in the cloud.

items.title: iZotope launches Photon, the company's first plugin developed with new owners Boris FX
items.excerpt: Photon is a stem separation tool with 12 machine-learning models for demixing and denoising audio, available as a standalone app and ARA plugin - iZotope's first release under Boris FX.

items.title: iZotope Photon: GPU-Powered Stem Separation
items.excerpt: iZotope Photon is a new ARA plugin and desktop app for ML stem splitting (including drum-kit splits) that runs on the GPU and has built-in audio restoration features.

items.title: Tamber 2.0 Review: 'This suite is exactly the kind of thing we've been waiting to see'
items.excerpt: MusicTech reviews Tamber 2.0, an AI-driven suite of Ableton/Max devices from an indie developer - pitched as the answer to what AI can do for independent music-software makers.

items.title: More AI Detector False Positives Emerge In Rapid Succession: Do Indie Musicians Have a Serious Problem Here?
items.excerpt: AI-music detectors are flagging electro-synth tracks as AI-generated - even original recordings made in the 1980s - raising the risk that indie artists get mislabelled or penalised by platforms.

items.title: Is Spotify's Anti-Spam Crackdown Catching Legitimate Music in the Crossfire?
items.excerpt: Data from 11A shows follower declines across 50 bot-free user playlists, suggesting Spotify's effort to curb AI-driven slop may be overcorrecting and hurting discovery for real artists.

items.title: MLC Formally Opposes Udio's Streaming-Data Subpoena, Citing Two to Three Weeks of Staff Time
items.excerpt: The Mechanical Licensing Collective is pushing back on AI music company Udio's subpoena for streaming data, saying compliance would take two to three weeks of staff time.

items.title: A&R startup Acaply wants to help producers easily source vocals
items.excerpt: With voice-cloning tech letting singers' voices be copied without permission, startup Acaply pitches a consent-based marketplace for producers to source real vocalists.

items.title: GEMA on AI: 'The most important thing is we get an output remuneration'
items.excerpt: After its initial win against Suno in Germany, GEMA general counsel Dr Kai Welp says the society's priority is remuneration on AI outputs, not just training licences.

items.title: AI roundup: Lyria lawsuit, Anthropic's Q3, OpenAI pile-in
items.excerpt: Music Ally's AI roundup: the Alphabet shareholder suit over Lyria training, amicus briefs piling into the OpenAI fair-use cases, and other AI-music developments.

items.title: More YouTube creators can now use AI to replace copyrighted songs
items.excerpt: YouTube is expanding access to its AI-powered Replace Song feature, which generates royalty-free AI instrumentals to swap in for Content ID-claimed music. (Off-list: on-list outlets had no item; date from Neowin RSS, page Cloudflare-blocked.)

items.title: [인터뷰] "낮에는 건자재 지점장, 밤에는 AI 뮤지션"…전자음악 아티스트 시릴 히메네스 ①
items.excerpt: 정통 음악 교육 없이 수노(Suno) AI로 프롬프트 제어와 집중 청취를 거쳐 정규 앨범을 완성한 프랑스 하우스 아티스트 시릴 히메네스의 제작 과정 인터뷰.

items.title: Text-to-music Generation via Structured Captions AND Interpretable Evaluation
items.excerpt: Proposes training latent diffusion/flow text-to-music models on structured captions, with an interpretable evaluation scheme for how well outputs follow each caption attribute.

items.title: How Close to the Theme? Similarity-Label Conditioning for Game Music Generation
items.excerpt: A music model further trained to control how similar each new section is to an original theme - from near repetition to new material - addressing game music's need for long, varied repetition.

items.title: Piano2Pop: Expanding Piano Demos into Pop Productions Without Aligned Supervision
items.excerpt: Piano2Pop conditions a pretrained flow-matching music model on piano rolls to expand a piano MIDI demo into a full instrumental pop production, without aligned training pairs.
